content: Penicillin V Potassium Tablets USP, 250 mg (equivalent to 400,000 units), are manufactured as round, biconvex, white tablets. These tablets are imprinted with PVK 250 and have a break score on one side, while the reverse side is marked with GG 949. They are available in bottles containing 100 tablets (NDC 0781-1205-01) or 1000 tablets (NDC 0781-1205-10). Penicillin V Potassium Tablets USP, 500 mg (equivalent to 800,000 units), are produced as oblong, biconvex, white tablets. These tablets are imprinted with PVK 500 on one side and GG 950 on the reverse side, with break scores present on both sides. They are supplied in bottles containing 100 tablets (NDC 0781-1655-01) or 1000 tablets (NDC 0781-1655-10). The tablets should be stored at a controlled room temperature of 20° to 25°C (68° to 77°F), as specified by the USP Controlled Room Temperature guidelines.
